channel.title: AzRoleWatcher
channel.description: Continuously monitor roles and permissions in Microsoft Entra ID and Azure.

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 5cf89f2f-ccaa-445e-84aa-48d3e203ddf9
Display name: DiskSnapshotImmutabilityOperator Service Role
Description: Can set an ImmutabilityPolicyType: unlocked on a snapshot and can modify the unlocked immutability policy (extend, reduce or remove). Cannot set or modify a locked immutability policy.
Link: https://management.azure.com/5cf89f2f-ccaa-445e-84aa-48d3e203ddf9?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 541b4c51-7349-4db1-b5af-298b9f20dd79
Display name: DiskSnapshotImmutabilityAdmin Service Role
Description: Can set a new locked immutability policy and modify (extend) it. Cannot change ImmutabilityPolicyType from locked to unlocked for an active immutable policy, and cannot reduce the ImmutabilityPolicyDurationDays for a locked immutability policy.
Link: https://management.azure.com/541b4c51-7349-4db1-b5af-298b9f20dd79?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: bdbf2dae-53ba-4c03-8ce9-94534a11a9b3
Display name: Cloud Device Platform Data Owner
Description: Read and manage Cloud Device Platform data for partner businesses only. Does not grant sandbox access, ARM management, or role-assignment permissions.
Link: https://management.azure.com/bdbf2dae-53ba-4c03-8ce9-94534a11a9b3?api-version=2022-04-01
